title: Statistics
intro: Numbers for your profile. Only totals are shown, never individual visitors.

period.outOfRange: Choose a day up to today.

problem.invalid: Choose a date for “From” and “To”. Showing the last {days} days.
problem.order: “From” is after “To”. Showing the last {days} days.
problem.future: “To” is in the future. Showing the last {days} days.
problem.tooLong: A period has at most {max} days. Showing the last {days} days.

kpi.heading: Key figures
kpi.previous: {days, plural, one {the day before} other {the # days before}}
kpi.footnote: Profile views count once per visitor and day, never your own. Contact requests are new conversations, booking requests are requests sent. Favourites are additions minus removals. Days in Swiss time.

funnel.title: From search to booking
funnel.footnote: An impression counts each time your profile appears on a results page. The rate is the share of the step above; without a number in the step above it shows “–”. Contact actions are new conversations, confirmed bookings are accepted requests.

views.title: Profile views per day
views.footnote: One view per visitor and day; your own views do not count. Days in Swiss time.

chart.empty: No data for this period yet

searches.title: Searches you appeared in
searches.footnote: Only the filters of a search are counted, such as region or language, never the text entered. At most 20 searches are shown.

media.title: Media by views
media.footnote: One view per visitor, media item and day, when opened in the large view. At most 20 media items are shown.

state.slow: Loading is taking longer than usual.
state.errorDescription: Your numbers are saved. Reload the page to try again.
